tasks.title: Status button not updating from text entered after session close
tasks.description: When a session is closed, any status text entered in the status input field is not being reflected in the UI. The status button should update to show the new text immediately when it's submitted, regardless of whether the session is still active. Investigation needed to determine if this is a client-side state sync issue, a WebSocket connection drop, or a server-side persistence problem.

tasks.title: LangGraph: Spike + Foundation (Phases 1-3)
tasks.description: Validate the Python sidecar HTTP bridge pattern, build the /lang skill entry point and agent dispatch layer, define TaskState, and build the StateGraph stubs + FastAPI executor. This is the go/no-go spike before any node implementation.

proofUnits.title: Python sidecar HTTP bridge responds
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: Running sidecar_spike.py FastAPI server responds to a test HTTP POST /advance with 200 and a stub node result.

proofUnits.title: SQLite checkpoint survives sidecar restart
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: After running to a pause point, killing Python process, and restarting, GET /state returns the last checkpointed node — not START.

proofUnits.title: /lang skill file invokes executor
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: Running /lang 24 starts the Python sidecar and receives a response from POST /advance.

proofUnits.title: Agent dispatch callback works from Python node
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: POST /dispatch-agent on server.js invokes the UI-selected agent and returns its text response.

proofUnits.title: StateGraph compiles and runs to first node
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: task_graph.py compiles, StateGraph instantiates, and a test invoke runs plan_node stub without errors.
